recipe: Pinned BiRefNet-matting: 1024 mask inference resized to unchanged RGB dimensions; canonical eight-bit semantic alpha. Only two original pixels around its opaque contour also use measured separated plate chroma (magenta32/green16/blue32 protected foreground band); uniform plate assertion unchanged. Opaque output retains original RGB; soft edges unmix plate. Alpha<8 removed; connected regions retained when containing alpha>=128. Fixed anatomical scale/anchor, no stabilization or interpolation.
